info.title: Goodays API
info.description: Goodays (formerly Critizr) REST API for managing your customer experience environment: places, levels, surveys, users, customer reviews (responses), solicitations (email/SMS outreach), events, and statistics. Reconstructed by API Evangelist from the per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments published on the Goodays ReadMe docs.
